title: AlloGen: Conformation-Selective Binder Generation with Differential State Scoring
abstract: arXiv:2606.05474v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Protein binder design commonly optimizes compatibility with a single receptor conformation, leaving preference over alternative functional states unresolved. To address this gap, we introduce AlloGen, a modular method that decouples backbone generation from state-selectivity scoring. We train its SE(3)-invariant interface graph transformer, $Q_\theta$, through interface-quality regression followed by paired conformational discrimination. By comparing scores across states, we rerank candidates and guide frozen backbone generators without retraining. On a benchmark of 65 targets spanning 15 protein families, $Q_\theta$ achieved a mean Spearman correlation of $0.520$ on eight held-out targets. All 15 evaluated generator-guidance combinations achieved positive predicted selectivity averaged over these targets, and RFdiffusion with Langevin refinement reached $\bar{S}_{\mathrm{cons}}=0.677$ on calmodulin (CaM). translated_title: AlloGen：基于差分状态评分的构象选择性结合剂生成
translated_abstract: 蛋白质结合剂设计通常只优化与单一受体构象的兼容性，而未能解决对其他功能状态的选择偏好问题。为填补这一空白，我们提出了AlloGen，这是一种模块化方法，将主链生成与状态选择性评分解耦。我们通过界面质量回归和成对构象判别两个阶段，训练其SE(3)不变的界面图变换器 $Q_\theta$。通过比较不同状态间的评分，我们对候选结合剂进行重排序，并在无需重新训练的情况下引导冻结的主链生成器。在一个涵盖15个蛋白质家族、共65个靶点的基准测试中，$Q_\theta$ 在8个保留靶点上取得了平均0.520的Spearman相关系数。所有15种评估的生成器-引导组合在这些靶点上均实现了正的预测选择性，其中RFdiffusion结合朗之万精修在钙调蛋白（CaM）上达到了 $\bar{S}_{\mathrm{cons}}=0.677$。
tldr: AlloGen提出了一种将主链生成与状态选择性评分解耦的模块化方法，通过SE(3)不变的界面图变换器 $Q_\theta$ 对不同构象状态进行差分评分，从而在无需重新训练的情况下重排序候选并引导冻结的生成器，生成对特定受体构象状态具有选择性的蛋白质结合剂。
en_tdlr: AlloGen is a modular method that decouples backbone generation from state-selectivity scoring, using a differentially trained SE(3)-invariant interface graph transformer to rerank candidates and guide frozen backbone generators to create protein binders selective for specific receptor conformational states without retraining.
